Question: Which of the given formulas of PL is the best symbolization of the following sentence?
If Beth rides her bike, she gets to work earlier.

A. B ⊃ W
B. W ⊃ B
C. B ≡ W
D. Both A and B

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
